generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Above Forestry works APO has been sent to Chief Conservator of Forests (Territorial), Bangalore for seeking approval. Upon awaiting of Approval Tender has been floated.
Works has been called on indicative Rates. Rates will be revised as per 2026-27 SSR Rates data sheets

Tenderer must have at least three years experience in Forestry works in any of the Forest Division, in Karnataka Forest Department, such as excavation pits for Raising of polythene bagged seedlings / Soil Moisture Conservation Maintenance of Seedlings, Maintenance of Plantation and related works/Raising of Plantations And work experience certificate should have obtained from the Officer not below the rank of Deputy Conservator of Forests.

The competent authority i.e. Deputy Conservator of Forests, Social Forestry Division, Chickballapur shall have the right to cancel the entire process of tender through e procurement without assigning any reason whatsoever. In such circumstance, the tenderer shall not be eligible for any interest on the EMD amount paid by him. Further the Deputy Conservator of Forests, Social Forestry Division, Chickballapur would not be liable to pay any cost which the tenderer may have borne with regard to the submission of the tender and its processes. In case of cancellation of the tender, the Tender Processing Fee paid to the e procurement platform is not refundable.

technicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should Produce Raising and Maintenance of plantation works done Certificate/Work Order for the works for the year 2023-24 2024-25 and 2025-26 for not less than 20.00 Lakhs in Forest Department, otherwise tender will be rejected.
To qualify for award of this contract each Tenderer should produce Karnataka Forest Contractor license for the year 2026-27
The aspiring bidders in its name should furnish GST / IT, & Service Tax registration certificate with PAN for the proceeding latest year.

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities (Usually 30% of the amount of Contract) for Work costing and (Credit Lines/ letter of credit /certificates from Banks) for Meeting Fund Requirement etc

Audit balance sheet for last three financial years (i.e. 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26) with copies of Income Tax returns statement filed and work done certificate should be uploaded as per the KTPP otherwise tender will be rejected.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Tender for Raising of 8x12 Seedlings 10,000 Nos at Patrenahalli Nursery of Shidlaghatta Social Forest Range during 2026-27

itemList.description: Raising of 4x6 seedlings for transplanting into 8x12 PBs
Cost of HDPE bags including 18% GST
Procurement of 0.9225 cum. Farm Yard Manure / Compost, 0.9225 cum. of Sand and 1.845 cum of Redearth. (4.20 cum. required for 8"x12" minus 0.51 cum of transplanted 4"x6" bag)
Mixing the ingredients, filling the polythene bags and arranging in rows after scraping the earth.
Transplanting of 4" x 6" size bagged seedlings into 8" x 12" size bags.
Watering to the Polythene bagged seedlings twice a day from 01-12-2026 to 31-03-2027 (121 days).
Shifting and grading the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion materials/compounds, their application, nursery pumpset fuel/maintainence/ electricty bill of pumpset and other unforseen items and charges.
